additions.name: integration_ledger_authorizations
additions.sql: CREATE TABLE integration_ledger_authorizations(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,org_id TEXT NOT NULL,binding_id TEXT NOT NULL,worker_id TEXT NOT NULL,realm TEXT NOT NULL,client_id TEXT NOT NULL,redirect_uri TEXT NOT NULL,state_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,credential_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,authority TEXT NOT NULL,expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL,state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN('pending','exchanging','completed','canceled','denied','unknown','expired')),claim TEXT,started_at INTEGER,installed_revision INTEGER) STRICT
